title: rhododendron oreodoxa var. fargesii
intro: Rhododendron oreodoxa var. fargesii, commonly known as Farges' rhododendron, is a species of flowering plant in the heath family, native to the mountainous regions of China. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to promote overall health and well-being, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Farges' rhododendron include reducing fever, alleviating cough and respiratory issues, and promoting digestive health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
